scope: Ordinary ScenarioSession/Realm Worker, live AI and replication, normal GPU presentation, idle player. Same seeded crowd layout, device, viewport and 60Hz target; two six-second samples after four-second warmup, reversing lane order in trial two.
limits: This compares complete delivered builds, not isolated engine cost. Frozen 202 lab uses a static schematic grid/camera; current lab uses normal cached terrain and player-follow presentation. Worker costs include contention and gameplay changes.
384 nearby NPCs is a stress case and neither build sustains 60Hz authority. Smooth main-thread frames do not establish authority headroom.
Two short samples on one physical Chromebook do not establish all devices, long thermal runs, moving-player replay stress, natural-world content or multi-client capacity.
navigator.deviceMemory is a browser bucket, not measured physical RAM. SSH startup was manual for this boot; no reboot/repair was performed.
